import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams['font.family'] = 'serif'
plt.rcParams['mathtext.fontset'] = 'dejavuserif'

# Data
data = {
    'Pi0 (no refinement)': {
        'marker': 'o', 'color': '#3274A1', 'size': 60, 'zorder': 5,
        'points': {
            'LoRA baseline': (0, 82),
            'Full-FT baseline': (0.5, 83),
            'A1-LoRA (Pi0)': (0, 91.5),
            'A3 (Pi0)': (0, 74.5),
        }
    },
    'Oracle (GT SDF)': {
        'marker': 'D', 'color': '#8B5CF6', 'size': 55, 'zorder': 5,
        'points': {
            'Oracle-adaptive': (0, 75),
            'Oracle-fixed': (0, 73.1),
            'Oracle-feature': (0, 76.9),
        }
    },
    'Pi0.5 baseline': {
        'marker': 's', 'color': '#2CA02C', 'size': 55, 'zorder': 5,
        'points': {
            'Pi0.5 s0': (73, 28),
            'Pi0.5 s1': (76, 25),
            'Pi0.5 s2': (75, 27.5),
        }
    },
    r'Pi0.5+A1 ($\lambda$-blend)': {
        'marker': '*', 'color': '#E8740C', 'size': 180, 'zorder': 6,
        'points': {
            r'$\lambda$=0.005': (47, 58),
            r'$\lambda$=0.01': (49, 56.5),
        }
    },
    'Pi0.5 spatial': {
        'marker': '^', 'color': '#7F7F7F', 'size': 60, 'zorder': 5,
        'points': {
            'Pi0.5 spatial': (57.5, 13),
        }
    },
}

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 4), dpi=300)

# "Fake safety" zone
ax.axhspan(70, 100, xmin=0, xmax=0.08, color='#D3D3D3', alpha=0.25, zorder=1)
ax.text(3.5, 96, '"Fake safety"\nzone', fontsize=6.5, color='#888888',
        ha='center', va='top', style='italic')

# Plot each group
for group_name, info in data.items():
    xs = [p[0] for p in info['points'].values()]
    ys = [p[1] for p in info['points'].values()]
    ax.scatter(xs, ys, marker=info['marker'], c=info['color'],
               s=info['size'], label=group_name, edgecolors='white',
               linewidths=0.5, zorder=info['zorder'])

# Annotations with manual offsets to avoid overlap
offsets = {
    'LoRA baseline': (6, -2),
    'Full-FT baseline': (6, 2),
    'A1-LoRA (Pi0)': (6, 0),
    'A3 (Pi0)': (5, -4),
    'Oracle-adaptive': (6, 1),
    'Oracle-fixed': (6, -3),
    'Oracle-feature': (6, 3),
    'Pi0.5 s0': (-3, -7),
    'Pi0.5 s1': (4, -6),
    'Pi0.5 s2': (-3, 4),
    r'$\lambda$=0.005': (-4, 5),
    r'$\lambda$=0.01': (4, -6),
    'Pi0.5 spatial': (5, 4),
}

for group_name, info in data.items():
    for label, (x, y) in info['points'].items():
        dx, dy = offsets.get(label, (5, 3))
        ax.annotate(label, (x, y), textcoords='offset points',
                    xytext=(dx, dy), fontsize=5.5, color=info['color'],
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color=info['color'],
                                    lw=0.4, shrinkA=0, shrinkB=2) if abs(dx) > 4 or abs(dy) > 4 else None)

# Pareto front
all_points = []
for info in data.values():
    for x, y in info['points'].values():
        all_points.append((x, y))

all_points.sort(key=lambda p: p[0])
pareto = []
max_y = -1
for x, y in all_points:
    if y > max_y:
        pareto.append((x, y))
        max_y = y

# Sort pareto by x for plotting, and also include points that form the front
# Recompute: pareto front = non-dominated points (no other point has both higher TSR and higher CAR)
pareto_pts = []
for x1, y1 in all_points:
    dominated = False
    for x2, y2 in all_points:
        if x2 >= x1 and y2 >= y1 and (x2 > x1 or y2 > y1):
            dominated = True
            break
    if not dominated:
        pareto_pts.append((x1, y1))

pareto_pts.sort(key=lambda p: p[0])
if pareto_pts:
    px, py = zip(*pareto_pts)
    ax.plot(px, py, '--', color='#333333', linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.5, zorder=3, label='Pareto front')

ax.set_xlim(-3, 100)
ax.set_ylim(0, 100)
ax.set_xlabel('Task Success Rate (%)', fontsize=10)
ax.set_ylabel('Collision Avoidance Rate (%)', fontsize=10)
ax.tick_params(labelsize=8)
ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

legend = ax.legend(fontsize=6.5, loc='lower right', framealpha=0.9,
                   edgecolor='#CCCCCC', handletextpad=0.4, borderpad=0.5)
legend.get_frame().set_linewidth(0.5)

plt.tight_layout()
out = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-be-idea-gen-0515/projects/diff_collision_sdf/artifacts/figures/fig_tsr_car_scatter.pdf'
plt.savefig(out, bbox_inches='tight', dpi=300)
print(f'Saved: {out}')
plt.close()

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams['font.family'] = 'serif'
plt.rcParams['mathtext.fontset'] = 'dejavuserif'

methods = [
    'Oracle-fixed\n(GT SDF)',
    'A3 no-refine\n(learned SDF)',
    'Oracle-adaptive\n(GT SDF)',
    'Oracle-feature\n(GT SDF)',
    'LoRA baseline',
    'Full-FT baseline',
]
cars = [73.1, 74.5, 75.0, 76.9, 82.0, 83.0]

colors = [
    '#A78BFA',  # oracle-fixed - light purple
    '#3274A1',  # A3 - blue
    '#8B5CF6',  # oracle-adaptive - purple
    '#7C3AED',  # oracle-feature - dark purple
    '#9CA3AF',  # LoRA baseline - gray
    '#6B7280',  # Full-FT baseline - darker gray
]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 3.5), dpi=300)

y_pos = np.arange(len(methods))
bars = ax.barh(y_pos, cars, height=0.55, color=colors, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)

# Value labels
for bar, val in zip(bars, cars):
    ax.text(bar.get_width() + 0.8, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height() / 2,
            f'{val:.1f}%', va='center', ha='left', fontsize=8, color='#333333')

# Baseline average line
baseline_avg = (82.0 + 83.0) / 2
ax.axvline(x=baseline_avg, color='#6B7280', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.9, alpha=0.7, zorder=3)
ax.text(baseline_avg + 0.5, len(methods) - 0.3, 'No Refinement\navg', fontsize=6.5,
        color='#6B7280', va='bottom', ha='left', style='italic')

ax.set_yticks(y_pos)
ax.set_yticklabels(methods, fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel('Collision Avoidance Rate (%)', fontsize=10)
ax.set_xlim(65, 92)
ax.tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=8)
ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax.invert_yaxis()

plt.tight_layout()
out = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-be-idea-gen-0515/projects/diff_collision_sdf/artifacts/figures/fig_oracle_bar.pdf'
plt.savefig(out, bbox_inches='tight', dpi=300)
print(f'Saved: {out}')
plt.close()
